description: This script manages the installation and updating of VNDK snapshots for Android, including fetching artifacts, unzipping, renaming files, generating build files, and handling licensing checks.

methods.name: start_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch for the update process based on the build or defaults to 'local'.

methods.name: remove_old_snapshot
methods.description: Removes existing files in the installation directory to prepare for new snapshot.

methods.name: install_snapshot
methods.description: Fetches build artifacts from server or local directory, unzips them into the install directory, and renames certain directories.

methods.name: gather_notice_files
methods.description: Collects NOTICE files from architecture-specific directories into a common directory.

methods.name: post_processe_files_if_needed
methods.description: Renames specific library list files to include version suffixes and creates missing files.

methods.name: update_buildfiles
methods.description: Generates Android.bp build files using the provided buildfile generator.

methods.name: copy_owners
methods.description: Copies the OWNERS file into the install directory.

methods.name: check_gpl_license
methods.description: Checks for GPL license compliance in the project.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a git commit with the updated snapshot information.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function to orchestrate fetching, installing, licensing, and committing the VNDK snapshot.

methods.name: get_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the run function with parsed arguments.
